subject: The one feature 90% of couples skip
preview_text: This 30-second feature could save your next date night from disaster. See what you're missing.
body_paragraphs: I have to confess something. Most couples who download SoulPlan make the same mistake — they ignore the one feature that takes 30 seconds and changes everything. I almost did it myself.

You know that feeling when you're staring at your partner, both of you saying 'I don't know, what do you want to do?' and the night starts dying before it even begins. That's the routine trap. It's not about having no ideas — it's about having ideas that don't land.

Here's the secret: our AI date generator. Open the app, tap the spark icon, and tell it what you're both into — cheap eats, outdoor adventure, or even a stay-in vibe. In 30 seconds, you get five personalized date ideas, from budget-friendly to splurge-worthy. No scrolling, no guessing. Just a plan that makes you look like a hero.
Try it now before your next date night. Open SoulPlan and hit the spark icon. P.S. — Couples who use this feature report 3x more 'wow' moments. Don't let yours be the one that misses out.
